case_name: Smt. Sunita v. Shri Rajesh Kumar — full case name

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: wife, mother of two minor children
parties.respondent_defendant: husband, father of two minor children

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2005 and have two minor children. The wife claimed that the husband had deserted her and was not providing maintenance to her or their children. She sought divorce and custody of the children. The trial court allowed the petition for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is a sacred institution and the parties to it have a duty to maintain its sanctity.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a marriage is a sacred institution and the parties to it have a duty to maintain its sanctity.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has been guilty of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has been guilty of cruelty.

outcome.final_order: The final order granted divorce to the wife, awarded her custody of the two minor children, and directed the husband to pay maintenance to them.
